text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having overcome their trials, the Trainer 
and Wonder Acute had become a true team. 
After witnessing this, T.M. Opera O 
departed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we keep this up, we might even be able 
to challenge the Dirt King, Smart Falcon, 
by the end of the year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To further hone her skills, the two 
decided on the GⅢ Sirius Stakes as their 
next goal.
